definition: in a way nobody saw coming
description: A sunny stone square with a church clock tower, a fountain and pigeons. A man painted all over in bronze, posing as a street statue on a wooden box, suddenly bends forward, takes off his bronze hat and holds it out to a young woman in a white shirt and blue skirt. She jumps back with her mouth wide open in shock, then laughs with her hands at her chest. Her friend in a pink T-shirt grabs her arm, and an older man in a sun hat stands beside the box with his hand near his pocket.

en.question: What is the bronze man doing?

de.answer: Er bietet einer Frau seinen Hut an.
